login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your username and password to continue.

password.title: Change password
password.forcedIntro: For the safety of your account, choose a new password before you continue.
password.intro: Saving signs out every open session of this account.

auth.sessionExpired: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.

setup.title: First-time setup
setup.intro: Enter the owner account and the lab details. You can edit the lab details later in Settings.
setup.usernameHint: Letters, digits and . _ - only, no spaces.
setup.nameHint: Enter the name in Arabic, in English, or both.
setup.currencyHint: Once any amount is recorded, the currency code and decimal places can no longer change.
setup.language: Language of the program and documents
setup.timeZoneHint: Used to decide the lab's today.

validation.usernameFormat: Letters, digits and . _ - only, no spaces.
validation.labNameRequired: Enter the lab name in Arabic or in English.
validation.timeZone: Enter a valid time zone, e.g. Asia/Hebron.
validation.moneyFormat: Enter an amount such as 120 or 120.50.
validation.moneyDecimals_zero: This currency has no decimal places.
validation.moneyNegative: A negative amount is not allowed here.
validation.integerRange: Enter a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}}.

network.title: Cannot reach the program
network.body: Make sure the program's service is running on this computer, then try again.

forbidden.title: You do not have access to this page
forbidden.body: Ask the account owner to give you the right permission.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: It may have moved or been removed, or the link is wrong.

stale.title: The data changed somewhere else
stale.body: This data was changed in another window. Reload it, then try again.

route.title: This page could not be shown
route.body: Something unexpected happened. Reload the page; if it happens again, send the reference number to support.

list.activeHint: An inactive item is not offered for new cases and stays in old records.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.search: Search by name, clinic or phone
doctors.empty: No doctors yet. Add the first one.
doctors.name: Doctor name
doctors.openingBalanceHint: Positive: the doctor owes the lab. Negative (e.g. -50): the lab owes the doctor. Leave empty if none.
doctors.deactivated: The doctor has records, so they were deactivated instead of deleted.
doctors.deleteBody: If the doctor has an opening balance or cases, they are deactivated instead and kept in the records. Otherwise they are deleted together with their special prices.

prices.intro: A special price replaces the general price for this doctor on new case lines only; earlier lines keep their price.
prices.caption: Special prices of {{name}}
prices.removed: {{name}} is back to the general price.
prices.noWorkTypes: There are no work types yet.

workTypes.title: Work types
workTypes.intro: Each work type has a price per tooth. A new price affects new lines only.
workTypes.empty: No work types yet. Add your types and their prices.
workTypes.name: Work type
workTypes.priceNote: A new price affects new lines only; earlier cases keep their price.
workTypes.created: The work type has been added.
workTypes.updated: The work type has been saved.
workTypes.deleted: The work type has been deleted.
workTypes.deactivated: The work type is in use, so it was deactivated instead of deleted.
workTypes.reactivated: The work type is active again.
workTypes.deleteBody: If cases use it, it is deactivated instead. Otherwise it is deleted together with its special prices.

technicians.title: Technicians
technicians.intro: Technicians you can pick on a case.
technicians.name: Technician name
technicians.deactivated: The technician is used by cases, so they were deactivated instead of deleted.
technicians.deleteBody: If used by cases, they are deactivated instead.

expenseCategories.title: Expense categories
expenseCategories.intro: Categories of outgoing payments. The doctor refund category is needed by the system.
expenseCategories.name: Category name
expenseCategories.deactivated: The category is in use, so it was deactivated instead of deleted.
expenseCategories.deleteBody: If it is in use, it is deactivated instead.
expenseCategories.systemHint: This is the system category: it can be renamed only, not deactivated or deleted.

settings.title: Settings
settings.labProfileIntro: Shown on invoices, statements and receipts.
settings.sloganHint: A short line shown under the lab name on the Home screen, for example your motto. Leave it empty to show nothing.
settings.currencyLocked: Amounts have been recorded, so the currency code and decimal places can no longer change (amounts are not converted). Only the symbol can change.
settings.languageIntro: The language of the program for this installation, and of printed documents.
settings.numberingIntro: The first case and invoice numbers. They can change only before the first number is issued.
settings.numberLocked: The first number was issued, so the start cannot change. Next number: {{next}}.
settings.logoIntro: Shown in the sidebar and on documents. Without a logo, only the lab name is shown.
settings.logoHint: A PNG or JPEG image, up to 1 MB. Never shown larger than its own size.
settings.removeLogoBody: Only the lab name will show in the menu and on new documents.
settings.logoInvalidType: The logo must be a PNG or JPEG image.
settings.logoTooLarge: The file is larger than {{max}} MB.

date.invalid: Write the date as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2026-11-07.

chart.title: Select teeth
chart.label: Tooth chart
chart.hint: Move between teeth with the arrow keys and press Space to select or unselect a tooth.

shade.title: Choose a shade
shade.disclaimer: Screen colours are a guide only, not a replacement for a shade guide or a measuring device.
shade.frequentEmpty: The shades you use most will appear here.
shade.frequentError: The most used shades could not be loaded.

newCase.title: New case
newCase.intro: Select teeth on the chart, choose the work type, then press “Add work”.
newCase.addWork: Add work for the selected teeth ({{n}})
newCase.needTeeth: Select at least one tooth on the chart.
newCase.statusHint: Before delivery only; delivery is done later from the case page.
newCase.notesPlaceholder: Any extra notes about the case...
newCase.linesEmpty: No lines yet. Select teeth, choose the work type, then press “Add work”.
newCase.previewNote: Prices here are a preview only. On saving, the program sets the price: the doctor’s special price if there is one, otherwise the general price, or the manual price if you typed one.
newCase.noLines: Add at least one work line.
newCase.tooManyLines: A case cannot have more than {{max}} lines.
newCase.noWorkTypes: Add at least one work type first, then reopen “New case”.
newCase.expectedBeforeReceived: The expected delivery date must be on or after the received date.
newCase.receivedInFuture: The received date cannot be in the future.
newCase.savedBody: You can open the case or start a new one.
newCase.advanceHint: Optional. An advance is recorded as a payment linked to this case.
newCase.advanceTooBig: The advance cannot be larger than the case total.
newCase.advanceNeedsTotal: Add at least one work line before taking an advance.

cases.title: Cases
cases.search: Search by patient name or case number

caseDetails.title: Case {{no}}
caseDetails.cancelledNote: This case is cancelled and cannot be changed.
caseDetails.doctorFixed: The doctor cannot change after the case is created.

statusDialog.title: Change the case status
statusDialog.deliveryNext: Delivery is a step of its own: the next window asks about the money and the date to collect the rest.

cancelDialog.title: Cancel case {{no}}?
cancelDialog.body: Cancelling is final and cannot be undone. The case stays in the records as “Cancelled”.

editDialog.title: Edit case details
editDialog.saved: The case details have been saved.

lineDialog.title: Edit line
lineDialog.priceHint: Changing the price makes it a manual price.

deleteLineDialog.title: Remove the line “{{line}}”?
deleteLineDialog.body: The case total is recalculated after removing it.

why.cancelled: The case is cancelled and cannot be changed.
why.cancelAfterDelivery: A case can be cancelled only before delivery.
why.noStatus: The status cannot be changed now.
why.noEdit: This case cannot be edited now.
why.invoiced: The case is on invoice no. {{no}} — void the invoice first to edit or cancel it.

collectDialog.title: Date to collect the rest
collectDialog.hint: Not before the delivery date ({{date, ltr}}).

caseDetails.invoicedHint: it cannot be edited or cancelled until the invoice is voided; stage changes, delivery and payments are allowed.

payments.title: Incoming payment
payments.intro: Record money received from a doctor, then review the receipts below.
payments.saved: Payment {{voucher, ltr}} recorded. New balance: {{balance, ltr}}.
payments.savedChequeNote: The cheque counts only once it is cleared.
payments.search: Search voucher, doctor or cheque number
payments.voidBody: The payment stays in the records, marked as cancelled with your reason, and the doctor’s balance is restored. This cannot be undone.

errors.amountPositive: Enter an amount greater than zero.
errors.dateFuture: The payment date cannot be in the future.

cheques.title: Cheque register
cheques.intro: Cheques received from doctors and the lab’s own cheques. A cheque counts only once it is cleared.
cheques.search: Search cheque number, bank, doctor, payee or voucher
cheques.noChange: This cheque has no further status changes.
cheques.voidNoChange: The payment of this cheque is cancelled.
cheques.statusDialogTitle: Change the status of cheque {{no, ltr}}
cheques.returnedWarning: A returned cheque cannot be changed again. The amount returns to the doctor’s debt.
cheques.returnedWarningOut: A returned cheque cannot be changed again. The amount goes back to how it was before it cleared.

debts.title: Debts
debts.banner: Every amount due is computed automatically from case prices and payments, and recorded against the doctor. Open a doctor to see exactly how the amount is made up.

statement.title: Statement of account — {{name}}
statement.note: A cheque is shown on the day it was cleared; pending cheques are not part of the balance.

doctorPayments.title: Payments of {{name}}
doctorPayments.empty: No payments from this doctor yet.

casePayments.title: Payments
casePayments.none: No payments linked to this case.
casePayments.addWhy: A cancelled case cannot take new payments.
casePayments.pendingNote: A pending cheque is not counted as paid until it is cleared.
casePayments.creditNote: This case is cancelled; its payments stay in the doctor’s account as credit.

export.failed: The file could not be created. Try again.
export.nothing: There is nothing to export for these filters.

breakdown.title: What {{name}} owes
breakdown.intro: Every amount below comes from case prices and payments. Open cases are paid oldest first.
breakdown.nothingOwed: Nothing is owed by this doctor.
breakdown.creditOnly: The lab holds credit for this doctor; there are no open cases.
breakdown.loadError: The breakdown could not be loaded.
breakdown.refundStatus: No longer covered by his credit

receipts.title: Receipts summary
receipts.basis: By collection date: cash and transfers on their payment date, cheques on the day they cleared.

search.open: Search for a doctor or a case…
search.title: Search
search.label: Search doctors, cases and payments
search.placeholder: Doctor, patient, case number or voucher
search.hint: Type at least two letters, or a number.
search.emptyHint: Try fewer words, or open the cases list to search there.
search.description: Looks in doctors, cases and payments. Use the arrow keys to choose and Enter to open.

outgoing.title: Outgoing payment
outgoing.intro: Record an expense the lab paid, or an amount returned to a doctor, then review the expenses below.
outgoing.payeeHint: Type the name as it should appear, such as the landlord, a supplier or an employee.
outgoing.reserved: (reserved for refund cheques not cleared yet: {{amount, ltr}})
outgoing.dueHint: The date may be later (a post-dated cheque).
outgoing.savedRefund: ✅ Expense {{voucher, ltr}} saved (refund). New balance: {{balance, ltr}}.
outgoing.search: Search voucher, payee, doctor or cheque number
outgoing.loadError: The expenses could not be loaded.
outgoing.voidBody: The expense stays in the records marked “cancelled” with the reason you write, and no longer counts. If it was a refund to a doctor, his credit returns as it was. A cancellation cannot be undone.
outgoing.refundIntro: The most you can refund is the doctor’s credit, minus refund cheques not cleared yet.
outgoing.noCreditReason: There is no credit to refund.

errors.noCredit: There is no credit to refund.
errors.refundExceeds: The amount is more than the refundable credit ({{max, ltr}}).

expenses.title: Expenses summary
expenses.loadError: The expenses summary could not be loaded.
expenses.basis: By the day the money left: cash and transfers on their payment date, cheques on the day they cleared.

cashFlow.title: Cash summary for the period
cashFlow.loadError: The cash summary could not be loaded.

delivery.title: Deliver case {{no}}
delivery.description: For «{{doctor}}». Record what you received at delivery.
delivery.nothingDue: The case is fully paid: nothing to ask for at delivery.
delivery.pendingCheques: Cheques for this case not cleared yet ({{amount, ltr}}) are not asked for again.
delivery.noPaymentPermission: Recording money needs the payments permission; you can deliver with a date to collect.
delivery.collectOnHint: On that day the case appears in the notifications under «Collection due».
delivery.donePaid: Case {{no}} delivered and payment {{voucher, ltr}} recorded. New balance: {{balance, ltr}}.

errors.deliveredDate: The delivery date is between the received date and today.
errors.partialBelowDue: A part payment is less than the amount due; for all of it choose «in full».
errors.collectOnRequired: Set the date to collect the rest.
errors.collectOnBeforeDelivery: The collect date cannot be before the delivery date.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.loadError: The notifications could not be loaded.
notifications.emptyHint: Cases and cheques near or past their date will appear here.

list.title: Invoices
list.intro: Every invoice, statement and free invoice. An invoice is never edited after issue; to correct one, void it and issue another.
list.search: Search by invoice number or party
list.loadError: The invoices could not be loaded.

new.title: New invoice
new.intro: Choose the kind first. The preview beside the form is what will be printed, computed by the program.

typeHint.cases: Finished, un-invoiced cases of a doctor
typeHint.statement: Every case and payment with a running balance
typeHint.free: A one-off amount for a doctor or another party

new.noEligible: No cases are waiting to be invoiced.
new.rangeHint: Empty = the whole account until today
new.rangeInvalid: The start date is after the end date.
new.languageHint: Kept with the invoice; it can be reprinted in the other one later.
new.immutableNote: An invoice cannot be changed after it is issued, to protect it from tampering.
new.previewHint: Fill in the form to see the preview here.
new.previewError: The preview could not be made.

view.title: {{type}} no. {{no}}
view.cannotPrint: An invoice whose total does not match the program’s calculation cannot be printed.
view.pdfHint: To save a PDF, choose “Save as PDF” in the print dialog.
view.voidBody: The invoice stays in the list marked “Void” with its number; no balance changes.
view.voidBodyCases: The invoice stays in the list marked “Void” with its number and its cases become un-invoiced. No balance changes.

appearance.title: Invoice appearance
appearance.intro: Colours, font size and margins apply to every print; columns, logo, balances and the footer are kept with each invoice when it is issued.
appearance.lowContrast: The table header text is hard to read on this colour.
appearance.columnsHint: The “Total” column always stays. Empty width = automatic.
appearance.footerHint: Plain text, up to {{max}} characters and {{lines}} lines.

errors.margins: Margins are whole numbers from {{min}} to {{max}} mm.
errors.widths: A width is a whole number from {{min}} to {{max}} mm, or empty.

vouchers.voidNote: This payment is void; the voucher prints marked “Void” and keeps its number.

invoiceDoc.periodOpening: Balance at the start of the period
invoiceDoc.totalsMismatch: The total shown does not match the program’s calculation — check the lines.
